'''Duke''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[Woods]].

==Card info==
*+1 Maximum [[Sanity]]

Discard to immediately restore your Sanity to its maximum.

Duke is part of [["Ashcan" Pete]]'s fixed possessions.
